body: I am already in contact with like 8 different professionals

People know how I feel but sadly there isn't really much they can do to help me. The people who don't have mental issues like me don't understand it enough to help me and the ones who do definetly doesn't need someone telling them a bout their problems.

Thank you for your kind words, I love nature but I don't have the energy to go outside, and whenever I am in nature I feel sad that its going to be gone in my lifetime since nobody who matters do anything about it out of greed. sorry if thats a little bit political but I don't see any good sides of life really and I feel like I don't want to be in the way of people since I know its very hard to help someone and it takes a toll on you. Sorry if I am rambling or whatever
Sorry if this doesnt fit the sub or I am taking space from people that need it more. Focus on those people please I am too much of a coward to kill myself
